contact.title: ESTABLISH CONTACT
contact.intro: Channel open. WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach me; email for anything longer-form. Usually reply within a few hours.

summary: Frontend Developer with 5+ years building high-performance, reactive web apps with Angular (Signals, RxJS), React, and TypeScript. Focused on clean architecture, rendering performance, and UIs that hold up under real traffic. Uses modern AI tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to move faster without trading off quality.

points: Rebuilt how the UI updates itself on a high-traffic social-casino platform — migrating to Angular Signals, OnPush change detection, and RxJS-driven state — cutting wasted rendering work and keeping the app responsive under load.
Owned the parts of the product players touch most, shipping into a live production application on a tight sprint cycle.
Made the product work properly across every screen size and built a shared frontend styling system that keeps the UX consistent everywhere.
Used AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot) in daily development to ship features faster and cut repetitive work.
Built responsive, user-facing interfaces for web and mobile gaming services using Angular and Vue.js, integrating RESTful APIs across 20+ features.
Collaborated in an Agile / Scrum team and conducted regular design and code reviews.
Developed and maintained UIs for an IBM enterprise product using Angular and React, ensuring reliable functionality and a polished user experience.
Worked out client/server API contracts with backend engineers and built production interfaces from UX/UI designs.
Built a math exam-preparation mobile app from scratch — set up the React Native client and defined the frontend architecture the team built on, plus a React-based internal admin panel.
Stood up Firebase as the initial datastore and wrote a provisional API to keep the product moving while a backend engineer was being hired, working directly with the designer and product manager.

Implemented and customised the company's CRM and ran the supporting infrastructure — 2 Windows servers, a VoIP server with GSM and landline gateways, several web services, the local network and 20 workstations.
Developed an internal CRM module integrated with the VoIP system through the Yeastar API, automating call logging and linking calls to customer records — the work that moved me into development.

projects.name: EXPENSE TRACKER
points: Designed and built a full-stack personal-finance app end to end — Next.js 16 frontend, NestJS 11 backend, PostgreSQL with Prisma, self-hosted on a Linux VPS behind Docker Compose and Caddy.
Modeled money as derived balances with paired double-entry transfers, and built receipt-photo capture where Gemini 2.5 Flash extracts line items for review before saving.

projects.name: FOOD PLANNER
points: Built a full-stack meal-planning app end to end — Next.js 16 (App Router) frontend, NestJS backend, PostgreSQL with Prisma, with true RTL support across English, Hebrew, and Russian.
Used AI to generate full recipes — ingredients, steps, timing, nutrition — from a name or pasted text, and set up GitHub Actions CI/CD deploying over SSH on merge to main.

projects.name: HEBREW VOCABULARY TRAINER
points: Built a cross-platform Hebrew learning app end to end — Expo / React Native client and a NestJS API deployed on Google Cloud Run via GitHub Actions, with Firestore and Firebase Auth.
Integrated Google Gemini, with a runtime model fallback chain, to generate and correct word morphology, and built spaced-repetition study sessions using the SM-2 algorithm.

projects.name: SOCIAL-CASINO PLATFORM
projects.description: Social-casino platform (web and mobile WebView) with real-time gameplay, where I owned business-critical, player-facing UI in an Agile team. Drove a reactive rewrite on Angular Signals, OnPush change detection, and RxJS-based state to cut unnecessary re-renders, plus a reusable styling system for consistent, high-fidelity UX across every breakpoint.

projects.name: WEB & MOBILE GAMING UI
projects.description: Responsive, user-facing web interfaces for online gaming and betting services, built with Angular and Vue.js and wired to RESTful APIs across 20+ features. Worked in an Agile / Scrum team with regular design and code reviews.
